verses.t: By the star when it descends
verses.pickthall: By the Star when it setteth
verses.yusufAli: By the Star when it goes down
verses.rodwell: By the STAR when it setteth
verses.sale: By the star, when it setteth

verses.t: Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred
verses.pickthall: Your comrade erreth not, nor is deceived
verses.yusufAli: Your Companion is neither astray nor being misled
verses.rodwell: Your compatriot erreth not, nor is he led astray
verses.sale: your companion Mohammed erreth not, nor is he led astray

verses.t: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination
verses.pickthall: Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire
verses.yusufAli: Nor does he say (aught) of (his own) Desire
verses.rodwell: Neither speaketh he from mere impulse
verses.sale: Neither doth he speak of his own will

verses.t: It is not but a revelation revealed
verses.pickthall: It is naught save an inspiration that is inspired
verses.yusufAli: It is no less than inspiration sent down to him
verses.rodwell: The Koran is no other than a revelation revealed to him
verses.sale: It is no other than a revelation, which hath been revealed unto him

verses.t: Taught to him by one intense in strength
verses.pickthall: Which one of mighty powers hath taught him
verses.yusufAli: He was taught by one Mighty in Power
verses.rodwell: One terrible in power taught it him
verses.sale: One mighty in power, indued with understanding, taught it him

verses.t: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
verses.pickthall: One vigorous; and he grew clear to view
verses.yusufAli: Endued with Wisdom: for he appeared (in stately form)
verses.rodwell: Endued with wisdom. With even balance stood he
verses.sale: And He appeared

verses.t: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon
verses.pickthall: When he was on the uppermost horizon
verses.yusufAli: While he was in the highest part of the horizon
verses.rodwell: In the highest part of the horizon
verses.sale: in the highest part of the horizon

verses.t: Then he approached and descended
verses.pickthall: Then he drew nigh and came down
verses.yusufAli: Then he approached and came closer
verses.rodwell: Then came he nearer and approached
verses.sale: Afterwards He approached the prophet, and drew near unto him

verses.t: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer
verses.pickthall: Till he was (distant) two bows' length or even nearer
verses.yusufAli: And was at a distance of but two bow-lengths or (even) nearer
verses.rodwell: And was at the distance of two bows, or even closer
verses.sale: until He was at the distance of two bows length from him, or yet nearer

verses.t: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed
verses.pickthall: And He revealed unto His slave that which He revealed
verses.yusufAli: So did (Allah) convey the inspiration to His Servant- (conveyed) what He (meant) to convey
verses.rodwell: And he revealed to his servant what he revealed
verses.sale: And He revealed unto his servant that which He revealed

verses.t: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw
verses.pickthall: The heart lied not (in seeing) what it saw
verses.yusufAli: The (Prophet's) (mind and) heart in no way falsified that which he saw
verses.rodwell: His heart falsified not what he saw
verses.sale: The heart of Mohammed did not falsely represent that which he saw

verses.t: So will you dispute with him over what he saw
verses.pickthall: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he seeth
verses.yusufAli: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he saw
verses.rodwell: What! will ye then dispute with him as to what he saw
verses.sale: Will ye therefore dispute with him concerning that which he saw

verses.t: And he certainly saw him in another descent
verses.pickthall: And verily he saw him yet another time
verses.yusufAli: For indeed he saw him at a second descent
verses.rodwell: He had seen him also another time
verses.sale: He also saw him another time

verses.t: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary
verses.pickthall: By the lote-tree of the utmost boundary
verses.yusufAli: Near the Lote-tree beyond which none may pass
verses.rodwell: Near the Sidrah-tree, which marks the boundary
verses.sale: by the lote-tree beyond which there is no passing

verses.t: Near it is the Garden of Refuge
verses.pickthall: Nigh unto which is the Garden of Abode
verses.yusufAli: Near it is the Garden of Abode
verses.rodwell: Near which is the garden of repose
verses.sale: Near it is the garden of eternal abode

verses.t: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it]
verses.pickthall: When that which shroudeth did enshroud the lote-tree
verses.yusufAli: Behold, the Lote-tree was shrouded (in mystery unspeakable)
verses.rodwell: When the Sidrah-tree was covered with what covered it
verses.sale: When the lote-tree covered that which it covered

verses.t: The sight [of the Prophet] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit]
verses.pickthall: The eye turned not aside nor yet was overbold
verses.yusufAli: (His) sight never swerved, nor did it go wrong
verses.rodwell: His eye turned not aside, nor did it wander
verses.sale: his eye-sight turned not aside, neither did it wander

verses.t: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord
verses.pickthall: Verily he saw one of the greater revelations of his Lord
verses.yusufAli: For truly did he see, of the Signs of his Lord, the Greatest
verses.rodwell: For he saw the greatest of the signs of his Lord
verses.sale: And he really beheld some of the greatest signs of his Lord

verses.t: So have you considered al-Lat and al-'Uzza
verses.pickthall: Have ye thought upon Al-Lat and Al-'Uzza
verses.yusufAli: Have ye seen Lat. and 'Uzza
verses.rodwell: Do you see Al-Lat and Al-Ozza
verses.sale: What think ye of Allat, and Al Uzza

verses.t: And Manat, the third - the other one
verses.pickthall: And Manat, the third, the other
verses.yusufAli: And another, the third (goddess), Manat
verses.rodwell: And Manat the third idol besides
verses.sale: and Manah, that other third goddess

verses.t: Is the male for you and for Him the female
verses.pickthall: Are yours the males and His the females
verses.yusufAli: What! for you the male sex, and for Him, the female
verses.rodwell: What? shall ye have male progeny and God female
verses.sale: Have ye male children, and God female

verses.t: That, then, is an unjust division
verses.pickthall: That indeed were an unfair division
verses.yusufAli: Behold, such would be indeed a division most unfair
verses.rodwell: This were indeed an unfair partition
verses.sale: This, therefore, is an unjust partition

verses.t: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance
verses.pickthall: They are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which Allah hath revealed no warrant. They follow but a guess and that which (they) themselves desire. And now the guidance from their Lord hath come unto them
verses.yusufAli: These are nothing but names which ye have devised,- ye and your fathers,- for which Allah has sent down no authority (whatever). They follow nothing but conjecture and what their own souls desire!- Even though there has already come to them Guidance from their Lord
verses.rodwell: These are mere names: ye and your fathers named them thus: God hath not sent down any warranty in their regard. A mere conceit and their own impulses do they follow. Yet hath "the guidance" from their Lord come to them
verses.sale: They are no other than empty names, which ye and your fathers have named goddesses. God hath not revealed concerning them any thing to authorize their worship. They follow no other than a vain opinion, and what their souls desire: Yet hath the true direction come unto them from their Lord

verses.t: Or is there for man whatever he wishes
verses.pickthall: Or shall man have what he coveteth
verses.yusufAli: Nay, shall man have (just) anything he hankers after
verses.rodwell: Shall man have whatever he wisheth
verses.sale: Shall man have whatever he wisheth for

verses.t: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first [life]
verses.pickthall: But unto Allah belongeth the after (life), and the former
verses.yusufAli: But it is to Allah that the End and the Beginning (of all things) belong
verses.rodwell: The future and the present are in the hand of God
verses.sale: The life to come, and the present life are God's

verses.t: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allah has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves
verses.pickthall: And how many angels are in the heavens whose intercession availeth naught save after Allah giveth leave to whom He chooseth and accepteth
verses.yusufAli: How many-so-ever be the angels in the heavens, their intercession will avail nothing except after Allah has given leave for whom He pleases and that he is acceptable to Him
verses.rodwell: And many as are the Angels in the Heavens, their intercession shall be of no avail Until God hath permitted it to whom he shall please and will accept
verses.sale: And how many angels soever there be in the heavens, their intercession shall be of no avail, until after God shall have granted permission unto whom He shall please and shall accept

verses.t: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names
verses.pickthall: Lo! it is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter who name the angels with the names of females
verses.yusufAli: Those who believe not in the Hereafter, name the angels with female names
verses.rodwell: Verily, it is they who believe not in the life to come, who name the angels with names of females
verses.sale: Verily they who believe not in the life to come give unto the angels a female appellation

verses.t: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all
verses.pickthall: And they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and lo! a guess can never take the place of the truth
verses.yusufAli: But they have no knowledge therein. They follow nothing but conjecture; and conjecture avails nothing against Truth
verses.rodwell: But herein they have no knowledge: they follow a mere conceit; and mere conceit can never take the place of truth
verses.sale: But they have no knowledge herein: They follow no other than a bare opinion; and a bare opinion attaineth not any thing of truth

verses.t: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life
verses.pickthall: Then withdraw (O Muhammad) from him who fleeth from Our remembrance and desireth but the life of the world
verses.yusufAli: Therefore shun those who turn away from Our Message and desire nothing but the life of this world
verses.rodwell: Withdraw then from him who turneth his back on our warning and desireth only this present life
verses.sale: Wherefore withdraw from him who turneth away from our admonition, and seeketh only the present life

verses.t: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided
verses.pickthall: Such is their sum of knowledge. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth, and He is Best Aware of him whom goeth right
verses.yusufAli: That is as far as knowledge will reach them. Verily thy Lord knoweth best those who stray from His Path, and He knoweth best those who receive guidance
verses.rodwell: This is the sum of their knowledge. Truly thy Lord best knoweth him who erreth from his way, and He best knoweth him who hath received guidance
verses.sale: This is their highest pitch of knowledge. Verily thy Lord well knoweth him who erreth from his way; and He well knoweth him who is rightly directed

verses.t: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward]
verses.pickthall: And unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may reward those who do evil with that which they have done, and reward those who do good with goodness
verses.yusufAli: Yea, to Allah belongs all that is in the heavens and on earth: so that He rewards those who do evil, according to their deeds, and He rewards those who do good, with what is best
verses.rodwell: And whatever is in the Heavens and in the Earth is God's that he may reward those who do evil according to their deeds: and those who do good will He reward with good things
verses.sale: Unto God belongeth whatever is in heaven and earth: That He may reward those who do evil, according to that which they shall have wrought; and may reward those who do well, with the most excellent reward

verses.t: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him
verses.pickthall: Those who avoid enormities of sin and abominations, save the unwilled offences - (for them) lo! thy Lord is of vast mercy. He is Best Aware of you (from the time) when He created you from the earth, and when ye were hidden in the bellies of your mothers. Therefor ascribe not purity unto yourselves. He is Best Aware of him who wardeth off (evil)
verses.yusufAli: Those who avoid great sins and shameful deeds, only (falling into) small faults,- verily thy Lord is ample in forgiveness. He knows you well when He brings you out of the earth, And when ye are hidden in your mothers' wombs. Therefore justify not yourselves: He knows best who it is that guards against evil
verses.rodwell: To those who avoid great crimes and scandals but commit only lighter faults, verily, thy Lord will be diffuse of mercy. He well knew you when he produced you out of the earth, and when ye were embryos in your mother's womb. Assert not then your own purity. He best knoweth who feareth him
verses.sale: As to those who avoid great crimes, and hainous sins, and are guilty only of lighter faults; verily thy Lord will be extensive in mercy towards them. He well knew you when He produced you out of the earth, and when ye were embryo's in your mothers' wombs: Wherefore justify not your selves: He best knoweth the man who feareth Him

verses.t: Have you seen the one who turned away
verses.pickthall: Didst thou (O Muhammad) observe him who turned away
verses.yusufAli: Seest thou one who turns back
verses.rodwell: Hast thou considered him who turned his back
verses.sale: What thinkest thou of him who turneth aside from following the truth

verses.t: And gave a little and [then] refrained
verses.pickthall: And gave a little, then was grudging
verses.yusufAli: Gives a little, then hardens (his heart)
verses.rodwell: Who giveth little and is covetous
verses.sale: and giveth little, and covetously stoppeth his hand

verses.t: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees
verses.pickthall: Hath he knowledge of the Unseen so that he seeth
verses.yusufAli: What! Has he knowledge of the Unseen so that he can see
verses.rodwell: Is it that he hath the knowledge and vision of the secret things
verses.sale: Is the knowledge of futurity with him, so that he seeth the same

verses.t: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
verses.pickthall: Or hath he not had news of what is in the books of Moses
verses.yusufAli: Nay, is he not acquainted with what is in the Books of Moses
verses.rodwell: Hath he not been told of what is in the pages of Moses
verses.sale: hath he not been informed of that which is contained in the books of Moses

verses.t: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations]
verses.pickthall: And Abraham who paid his debt
verses.yusufAli: And of Abraham who fulfilled his engagements
verses.rodwell: And of Abraham faithful to his pledge
verses.sale: and of Abraham who faithfully performed his engagements

verses.t: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
verses.pickthall: That no laden one shall bear another's load
verses.yusufAli: Namely, that no bearer of burdens can bear the burden of another
verses.rodwell: That no burdened soul shall bear the burdens of another
verses.sale: To wit: That a burdened soul shall not bear the burden of another

verses.t: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
verses.pickthall: And that man hath only that for which he maketh effort
verses.yusufAli: That man can have nothing but what he strives for
verses.rodwell: And that nothing shall be reckoned to a man but that for which he hath made efforts
verses.sale: and that nothing shall be imputed to a man for righteousness, except his own labour

verses.t: And that his effort is going to be seen
verses.pickthall: And that his effort will be seen
verses.yusufAli: That (the fruit of) his striving will soon come in sight
verses.rodwell: And that his efforts shall at last be seen in their true light
verses.sale: and that his labour shall surely be made manifest hereafter

verses.t: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense
verses.pickthall: And afterward he will be repaid for it with fullest payment
verses.yusufAli: Then will he be rewarded with a reward complete
verses.rodwell: That then he shall be recompensed with a most exact recompense
verses.sale: and that he shall be rewarded for the same with a most abundant reward

verses.t: And that to your Lord is the finality
verses.pickthall: And that thy Lord, He is the goal
verses.yusufAli: That to thy Lord is the final Goal
verses.rodwell: And that unto thy Lord is the term of all things
verses.sale: and that unto thy Lord will be the end of all things

verses.t: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
verses.pickthall: And that He it is who maketh laugh, and maketh weep
verses.yusufAli: That it is He Who granteth Laughter and Tears
verses.rodwell: And that it is He who causeth to laugh and to weep
verses.sale: and that He causeth to laugh, and causeth to weep

verses.t: And that it is He who causes death and gives life
verses.pickthall: And that He it is Who giveth death and giveth life
verses.yusufAli: That it is He Who granteth Death and Life
verses.rodwell: And that He causeth to die and maketh alive
verses.sale: and that He putteth to death, and giveth life

verses.t: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female
verses.pickthall: And that He createth the two spouses, the male and the female
verses.yusufAli: That He did create in pairs,- male and female
verses.rodwell: And that He hath created the sexes, male and female
verses.sale: and that He createth the two sexes, the male and the female

verses.t: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
verses.pickthall: From a drop (of seed) when it is poured forth
verses.yusufAli: From a seed when lodged (in its place)
verses.rodwell: From the diffused germs of life
verses.sale: of seed when it is emitted

verses.t: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the next creation
verses.pickthall: And that He hath ordained the second bringing forth
verses.yusufAli: That He hath promised a Second Creation (Raising of the Dead)
verses.rodwell: And that with Him is the second creation
verses.sale: and that unto Him appertaineth another production, namely, the raising of the dead again to life hereafter

verses.t: And that it is He who enriches and suffices
verses.pickthall: And that He it is Who enricheth and contenteth
verses.yusufAli: That it is He Who giveth wealth and satisfaction
verses.rodwell: And that He enricheth and causeth to possess
verses.sale: and that He enricheth, and causeth to acquire possessions

verses.t: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius
verses.pickthall: And that He it is Who is the Lord of Sirius
verses.yusufAli: That He is the Lord of Sirius (the Mighty Star)
verses.rodwell: And that He is the Lord of Sirius
verses.sale: and that He is the Lord of the dog-star

verses.t: And that He destroyed the first [people of] 'Aad
verses.pickthall: And that He destroyed the former (tribe of) A'ad
verses.yusufAli: And that it is He Who destroyed the (powerful) ancient 'Ad (people)
verses.rodwell: And that it was He who destroyed the ancient Adites
verses.sale: and that He destroyed the ancient tribe of Ad

verses.t: And Thamud - and He did not spare [them]
verses.pickthall: And (the tribe of) Thamud He spared not
verses.yusufAli: And the Thamud nor gave them a lease of perpetual life
verses.rodwell: And the people of Themoud and left not one survivor
verses.sale: and Thamud, and left not any of them alive

verses.t: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing
verses.pickthall: And the folk of Noah aforetime, Lo! they were more unjust and more rebellious
verses.yusufAli: And before them, the people of Noah, for that they were (all) most unjust and most insolent transgressors
verses.rodwell: And before them the people of Noah who were most wicked and most perverse
verses.sale: and also the people of Noah, before them; for they were most unjust and wicked

verses.t: And the overturned towns He hurled down
verses.pickthall: And Al-Mu'tafikah He destroyed
verses.yusufAli: And He destroyed the Overthrown Cities (of Sodom and Gomorrah)
verses.rodwell: And it was He who destroyed the cities that were overthrown
verses.sale: And He overthrew the cities which were turned upside down

verses.t: And covered them by that which He covered
verses.pickthall: So that there covered them that which did cover
verses.yusufAli: So that (ruins unknown) have covered them up
verses.rodwell: So that that which covered them covered them
verses.sale: and that which covered them, covered them

verses.t: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt
verses.pickthall: Concerning which then, of the bounties of thy Lord, canst thou dispute
verses.yusufAli: Then which of the gifts of thy Lord, (O man,) wilt thou dispute about
verses.rodwell: Which then of thy Lord's benefits wilt thou make a matter of doubt
verses.sale: Which, therefore, of thy Lord's benefits, O man, wilt thou call in question

verses.t: This [Prophet] is a warner like the former warners
verses.pickthall: This is a warner of the warners of old
verses.yusufAli: This is a Warner, of the (series of) Warners of old
verses.rodwell: He who warneth you is one of the warners of old
verses.sale: This our apostle is a preacher like the preachers who preceded him

verses.t: The Approaching Day has approached
verses.pickthall: The threatened Hour is nigh
verses.yusufAli: The (Judgment) ever approaching draws nigh
verses.rodwell: The day that must draw nigh, draweth nigh already
verses.sale: The approaching day of judgment draweth near

verses.t: Of it, [from those] besides Allah, there is no remover
verses.pickthall: None beside Allah can disclose it
verses.yusufAli: No (soul) but Allah can lay it bare
verses.rodwell: and yet none but God can reveal its time
verses.sale: There is none who can reveal the exact time of the same, besides God

verses.t: Then at this statement do you wonder
verses.pickthall: Marvel ye then at this statement
verses.yusufAli: Do ye then wonder at this recital
verses.rodwell: Is it at these sayings that ye marvel
verses.sale: Do ye, therefore, wonder at this new revelation

verses.t: And you laugh and do not weep
verses.pickthall: And laugh and not weep
verses.yusufAli: And will ye laugh and not weep
verses.rodwell: And that ye laugh and weep not
verses.sale: and do ye laugh, and not weep

verses.t: While you are proudly sporting
verses.pickthall: While ye amuse yourselves
verses.yusufAli: Wasting your time in vanities
verses.rodwell: And that ye are triflers
verses.sale: spending your time in idle diversions

verses.t: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him]
verses.pickthall: Rather prostrate yourselves before Allah and serve Him
verses.yusufAli: But fall ye down in prostration to Allah, and adore (Him)
verses.rodwell: Prostrate yourselves then to God and worship
verses.sale: But rather worship God, and serve him
